why: No vendor block is present, so this can only be restored from the portable layer. A consumer that only reads its own files has implemented a backup, not this format.

checks.bodyMass: Recorded in [lb_av]. A consumer must convert rather than trust the number.
checks.dayAssignment: The 07:00+02:00 weigh-in folds onto 2026-08-10 using the offset the timestamp carries, not the reader's local zone.
checks.energy: No energyConsumed is recorded, so the day's energy is the sum of its entries.
